### BTOnboardingStatus

http://linksys.com/jnap/nodes/autoonboarding/BTOnboardingStatus


#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: Pending
  - **Description**: Device is pending onboarding.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Connecting
  - **Description**: Parent node is connecting to the device.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Onboarding
  - **Description**: Device is being onboarded.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Onboarded
  - **Description**: Device was successfully onboarded.
- Item:
  - **Value**: LostConnection
  - **Description**: Lost Bluetooth connection to the device while onboarding.
- Item:
  - **Value**: MasterModeOnly
  - **Description**: The discovered device cannot be onboarded, because it supports Master mode only.
- Item:
  - **Value**: FailedRSSIThreshold
  - **Description**: RSSI was too low to connect to the device.
- Item:
  - **Value**: FailedConnecting
  - **Description**: Failed connecting to the device.
- Item:
  - **Value**: FailedOnboarding
  - **Description**: Failed to onboard the device.

- Item:

- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.2
  - **Date**: 2018-06-20
  - **Notes**: Defined BTModeLimitStatus enum, which indicates the mode limit status of Uncofigured node. Added the modeLimit(BTModeLimitStatus) to BTDiscoveryData
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.1

  - **Notes**: Deprecated the following at Bluetooth2 service action BTRequestScanUnconfigured action BTGetScanResult action BTRequestConnect action BTGetConnectResult action BTRequestDisconnect action BTGetDisconnectResult action BTRequestScanBackhaulDownSlave action BTGetScanBackhaulDownSlaveResult Added the following at Bluetooth2 service action BTRequestScanUnconfigured2 action BTGetScanResult2 action BTRequestConnect2 action BTGetConnectResult2 action BTRequestDisconnect2 action BTGetDisconnectResult2 action BTRequestScanBackhaulDownSlave2 action BTGetScanBackhaulDownSlaveResult2
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.0
  - **Date**: 2016-12-01
  - **Notes**: Added APIs for detection and rebooting the Slaves which backhaul is down. Added the following: action BTRequestScanBackhaulDownSlave action BTGetScanBackhaulDownSlaveResult action BTReboot

# Core Service

NOTICE: The namespace prefix http://cisco.com/jnap/ has been deprecated but is still supported. All JNAP clients should switch to the new namespace prefix http://linksys.com/jnap/.

Copyright Notice © 2021 Belkin International, Inc. and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.

Contents Change History Services Core Core2 Core3 Core4 Core5 Core6 Core7 Core8 Core9 Actions CheckAdminPassword CheckAdminPassword2 CheckAdminPassword3 FactoryReset FactoryReset2 GetAdminPasswordAuthStatus GetAdminPasswordHint GetAdminPasswordRestrictions GetDataUploadUserConsent GetDeviceInfo GetUnsecuredWiFiWarning IsAdminPasswordDefault IsServiceSupported Reboot Reboot2 SetAdminPassword SetAdminPassword2 SetAdminPassword3 SetDataUploadUserConsent SetUnsecuredWiFiWarning Structures UnicodeRange


## Change History


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Revision**: 9.0.0
  - **Date**: 2024-09-19
  - **Notes**: Added Core9 service to reset specific network nodes based on uuid. Includes the following new actions: FactoryReset2
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 8.0.0
  - **Date**: 2024-09-18
  - **Notes**: Added Core8 service to reboot specific network nodes based on uuid. Includes the following new actions: Reboot2
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 7.0.0
  - **Date**: 2021-09-28
  - **Notes**: Added Core7 service to meet the password requirements for IMDA certification. Includes the following new actions: SetAdminPassword3 CheckAdminPassword3 GetAdminPasswordAuthStatus
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 6.0.0
  - **Date**: 2019-07-17
  - **Notes**: Added Core6 service to indicate the following actions now require authentication: GetAdminPasswordRestrictions GetDataUploadUserConsent
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 5.0.1
  - **Date**: 2017-04-11
  - **Notes**: Once disabled, SetUnsecuredWiFiWarning can no longer be enabled. Otherwise, it will return "ErrorCannotEnableUnsecuredWiFiWarning".
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 5.0.0
  - **Date**: 2017-02-27
  - **Notes**: Added Core5 service with new action IsServiceSupported.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 4.0.0
  - **Date**: 2016-01-06
  - **Notes**: Added Core4 service to support diagnostics data uploads. Introduced: action GetDataUploadUserConsent action SetDataUploadUserConsent
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 3.0.0
  - **Date**: 2015-07-29
  - **Notes**: Added Core3 service to support Admin password hint. Introduced: action SetAdminPassword2 action GetAdminPasswordHint
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 2.0.0
  - **Date**: 2012-11-14
  - **Notes**: Added Core2 service with action CheckAdminPassword2.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.0
  - **Date**: 2012
  - **Notes**: Initial release

  - **Description**: The password check function is currently delayed, as the result of a previous password failure. The next check cannot be executed until delayExpirationTime.

### SetDDNSSettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/ddns/SetDDNSSettings

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters

- Item:
  - **Name**: ddnsProvider
  - **Type**: DDNSProvider
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The desired DDNS provider.
- Item:
  - **Name**: dynDNSSettings
  - **Type**: DynDNSSettings
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The current DynDNS provider settings. This value must be present if and only if the value of the ddnsProvider parameter is DynDNS.
- Item:
  - **Name**: tzoSettings
  - **Type**: TZOSettings
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The current TZO provider settings. This value must be present if and only if the value of the ddnsProvider parameter is TZO.
- Item:
  - **Name**: noipSettings
  - **Type**: NoIPSettings
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The current No-IP provider settings. This value must be present if and only if the value of the ddnsProvider parameter is No-IP.

**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: OK
  - **Description**: Success.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Error
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidHostName
  - **Description**: The specified host name or mail exchange host name was invalid.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidPassword
  - **Description**: The specified password was invalid.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidUsername
  - **Description**: The specified username was invalid.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorMissingDynDNSSettings
  - **Description**: The DDNS provider was specified as DynDNS, but no DynDNS settings were specified.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorMissingMailExchangeSettings
  - **Description**: Mail exchange was specified as enabled, but no mail exchange settings were specified.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorMissingNoIPSettings
  - **Description**: The DDNS provider was specified as No-IP, but no No-IP settings were specified.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorMissingTZOSettings
  - **Description**: The DDNS provider was specified as TZO, but no TZO settings were specified.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorSuperfluousDynDNSSettings
  - **Description**: DynDNS settings were specified even though the specified DDNS provider was not DynDNS.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorSuperfluousMailExchangeSettings
  - **Description**: Mail exchange settings were specified even though mail exchange was specified as disabled.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorSuperfluousNoIPSettings
  - **Description**: No-IP settings were specified even though the specified DDNS provider was not No-IP.

### GetDevices

http://linksys.com/jnap/devicelist/GetDevices

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: deviceIDs
  - **Type**: UUID[]
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: An optional list of device IDs. If this value is specified, information will be returned only for those devices whose IDs appear in the list. If this value is not specified, the returned list of devices will not be filtered by device ID. Note that if an empty array is specified for this value, the returned list of devices will always be empty; in this case, the action serves only to query the most recent revision number.
- Item:
  - **Name**: sinceRevision
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: An optional revision number. If this value is specified, information will be returned only for devices that have been added, changed, or deleted since the specified revision number. If this value is not specified, the returned list of devices will not be filtered by revision number.



#### Output Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: revision
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The revision number corresponding to the most recent change to the device list data. Clients can use this revision number to detect whether the device's data has changed since a point in the past. Once the revision number reaches 2147483647, the next change to the device list will cause the revision number and the last revision number of every device to be reset to 0. This data is not persisted across reboots of the service's host device; after a reboot, the revision number of every device is 0.
- Item:
  - **Name**: devices
  - **Type**: Device[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of devices, if any, that satisfy the specified filter criteria.
- Item:
  - **Name**: deletedDeviceIDs
  - **Type**: UUID[]
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: A list of the unique IDs of devices that were deleted since the revision specified by the sinceRevision input parameter. If the sinceRevision parameter was not specified, this value is not present in the output. This data is not persisted across reboots of the service's host device.
- Item:
  - **Name**: ErrorInfo
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: Information about an error that occured while retrieving device information. This value will exist and only if result is ErrorDeviceDBFailure.



#### Result

http://linksys.com/jnap/devicelist/GetDevicesResult


**Details:**

- Item:

  - **Description**: Success.
- Item:

## Structures


### Device

http://linksys.com/jnap/devicelist/Device


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: deviceID
  - **Type**: UUID
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The unique ID associated with the device. The device list service generates this value the first time it discovers the device on the network. The same device will have different device IDs on different networks, since this value is specific to a particular instance of the device list service.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: lastChangeRevision
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The revision number of the most recent change that was made to this device's data. Clients can use the revision number to decide whether or not they need to refresh their cached information of the device. This data is notpersisted across reboots of the service's host device.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: model
  - **Type**: ModelInfo
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Information about the device model and version.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: unit
  - **Type**: UnitInfo
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Information about this particular instance of the device.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: isAuthority
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether the device is the authority on the local network.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: friendlyName
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: A "friendly" name for the device, as determined by the service's internal identification mechanism. This value may change when the service discovers new information about the device. This value is not modifiable by clients. Clients that want to override this name should store an override value in a property and implement business logic to check for that property before falling back to the friendly name. This value will not be present if the service is unable to determine a suitable friendly name for the device.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: knownMACAddresses
  - **Type**: MACAddress[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: A list of MAC addresses that are known to belong to the device's network adapters. Since a single physical device may have multiple network adapters, a device may appear as multiple devices in the device list. If the service is able to detect that the two "devices" are in fact the same physical device, it may automatically merge the device data. Otherwise, clients can invoke the MergeDevices action in order to manually trigger a merge operation.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: connections
  - **Type**: Layer3Connection[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: A list of the device's upstream connections to the network. If the device is currently offline, the list will be empty. If the device is online, the list will usually contain one item, since it is very rare for a device to be simultaneously connected to the same network through multiple network adapters.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: properties
  - **Type**: Property[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: A list of custom properties associated with the device.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: maxAllowedProperties
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The maximum number of properties that can be associated with the device at one time.

- Item:

  - **Date**: 2023-11-14
  - **Notes**: Added Diagnostics9 service to indicate support for system command execution in ExecSysCommand.

  - **Date**: 2019-07-29
  - **Notes**: Added Diagnostics8 service to indicate support for an IPv6 host address in StartTraceroute.

  - **Date**: 2018-07-16
  - **Notes**: Made GetSysinfoData not transaction-safe as it is blocking. Added Diagnostics6 service. The followings were added: action RequestSysinfoData2 action GetSysinfoRequestStatus2 action GetSysinfoData4 action GetSupportedSysinfoSections Removed Diagnostics4 and Diagnostics5 along with the followings: enum SectionName action RequestSysinfoData action GetSysinfoRequestStatus action GetSysinfoData3 action UploadSysinfoData

### StartPing

#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: host
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The IP or URL to ping. This must be a valid IPv4 address in dotted-quad notation, a valid IPv6 address in or a valid host name as defined in RFCs 952 and 1123.
- Item:
  - **Name**: packetSizeBytes
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The ping packet size in bytes. This value must be between 32 and 65500.
- Item:
  - **Name**: pingCount
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The number of times to ping the host. If this value is not specified, the number of pings is unlimited and the test will continue until StopPing is called. If specified, this value must be greater than 0.

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: rule
  - **Type**: DynamicIPv6ConnectionRule
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Dynamic IPv6 connection rule.



#### Output Parameters

**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: OK
  - **Description**: Success.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Error
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorDescriptionTooLong
  - **Description**: The specified description was longer than the maximum allowed length.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidExternalPort
  - **Description**: One of the specified ports was not between 0 and 65535.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidExternalPortRange
  - **Description**: One of the specified port ranges contained a first value that was greater than its last value.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorRuleAlreadyExist
  - **Description**: The rule specified for the IPv6 connection already exists
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorSessionDoesNotExist
  - **Description**: The specified session does not exit.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorTooManyRules
  - **Description**: Can not add this rule since the number of existing rules is already the maximum number of rules allowed.

  - **Name**: isDMZEnabled
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether the router's DMZ feature is currently enabled.
- Item:
  - **Name**: sourceRestriction
  - **Type**: DMZSourceRestriction
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The range of IP addresses that can access the destination server in the DMZ. If the value of the isDMZEnabled parameter is false, this value will not be present. If the value of the isDMZEnabled parameter is true and the sourceRestriction parameter is not present, all IP addresses are allowed to access the destination server.
- Item:
  - **Name**: destinationIPAddress
  - **Type**: IPAddress
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The destination server's IP address on the LAN. If the value of the isDMZEnabled parameter is false, this value will not be present. Otherwise, it will be present if and only if the destinationMACAddress parameter is not present. This value must be in the same subnet as the router's LAN host address (as defined by SetLANSettings), but not equal to the router's LAN host address and not fall inside the following reserved ranges: Address Block Description Reference 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.0 Subnetwork ID RFC 922, Section 7 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.255 Subnetwork Broadcast Address RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: Address Block
  - **Type**: Description
  - **Optional**: Reference
- Item:
  - **Name**: 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.0
  - **Type**: Subnetwork ID
  - **Optional**: RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.255
  - **Type**: Subnetwork Broadcast Address
  - **Optional**: RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: destinationMACAddress
  - **Type**: MACAddress
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The destination server's MAC address. If the value of the isDMZEnabled parameter is false, this value will not be present. Otherwise, it will be present if and only if the destinationIPAddress parameter is not present.

### SetDMZSettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/firewall/SetDMZSettings

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: isDMZEnabled
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether the router's DMZ feature should be enabled.
- Item:
  - **Name**: sourceRestriction
  - **Type**: DMZSourceRestriction
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The range of IP addresses that should be allowed to access the destination server in the DMZ. If the value of the isDMZEnabled parameter is false, this value is ignored. Otherwise, if this value is not present, all IP addresses will be allowed to access the destination server.
- Item:
  - **Name**: destinationIPAddress
  - **Type**: IPAddress
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The destination server's IP address on the LAN. If the value of the isDMZEnabled parameter is false, this value is ignored. Otherwise, either this parameter or the destinationMACAddress parameter, but not both, must be specified. This value must be in the same subnet as the router's LAN host address (as defined by SetLANSettings), but not equal to the router's LAN host address and not fall inside the following reserved ranges: Address Block Description Reference 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.0 Subnetwork ID RFC 922, Section 7 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.255 Subnetwork Broadcast Address RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: Address Block
  - **Type**: Description
  - **Optional**: Reference
- Item:
  - **Name**: 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.0
  - **Type**: Subnetwork ID
  - **Optional**: RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.255
  - **Type**: Subnetwork Broadcast Address
  - **Optional**: RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: destinationMACAddress
  - **Type**: MACAddress
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The destination server's MAC address. If the value of the isDMZEnabled parameter is false, this value is ignored. Otherwise, either this parameter or the destinationIPAddress parameter, but not both, must be specified. The following restrictions from the IANA are applied to the destination MAC address. The destination MAC address must not fall inside the following reserved ranges: Address Block Description Reference 00:00:00:00:00:00-00:00:00:00:03:00 Reserved RFC 5342 01:00:5e:00:00:00-01:00:5e:7F:FF:FF IPv4 multicast range RFC 1122 01:00:5e:80:00:00-01:00:5e:8F:FF:FF MPLS multicast range RFC 5332 01:00:5e:90:00:00 draft-ietf-mpls-tp-ethernet-addressing FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF Broadcast address RFC 5342
- Item:
  - **Name**: Address Block
  - **Type**: Description
  - **Optional**: Reference
- Item:
  - **Name**: 00:00:00:00:00:00-00:00:00:00:03:00
  - **Type**: Reserved
  - **Optional**: RFC 5342
- Item:
  - **Name**: 01:00:5e:00:00:00-01:00:5e:7F:FF:FF
  - **Type**: IPv4 multicast range
  - **Optional**: RFC 1122
- Item:
  - **Name**: 01:00:5e:80:00:00-01:00:5e:8F:FF:FF
  - **Type**: MPLS multicast range
  - **Optional**: RFC 5332
- Item:
  - **Name**: 01:00:5e:90:00:00
  - **Type**: draft-ietf-mpls-tp-ethernet-addressing
  - **Optional**: 
- Item:
  - **Name**: FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF
  - **Type**: Broadcast address
  - **Optional**: RFC 5342

### GetFirmwareUpdateStatus

http://linksys.com/jnap/firmwareupdate/GetFirmwareUpdateStatus

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


#### Output Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: lastSuccessfulCheckTime
  - **Type**: DateTime
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The last time that the device successfully checked for available firmware updates.
- Item:
  - **Name**: availableUpdate
  - **Type**: FirmwareUpdate
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: Information about an available firmware update. This value will not be present if no update is currently available, or if the firmware update service on the device is not aware that one is available.
- Item:
  - **Name**: pendingOperation
  - **Type**: FirmwareUpdateOperationStatus
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: Information about the firmware update operation, if any, that is currently in progress. This value will not be present if no firmware update operation is in progress.
- Item:
  - **Name**: lastOperationFailure
  - **Type**: FirmwareUpdateOperationFailure
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The reason why the most recent attempted firmware update operation failed. This value will not be present if the pendingOperation parameter is present, or if the most recent firmware update operation succeeded.



#### Result

http://linksys.com/jnap/firmwareupdate/GetFirmwareUpdateStatusResult


**Details:**

## Structures


### FirmwareAutoUpdateWindow

http://linksys.com/jnap/firmwareupdate/FirmwareAutoUpdateWindow


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: startMinute
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The minute of the day, in the device's local time, when the automatic firmware update window begins. For example, if this value is set to 1800, the device will perform automatic firmware update checks at 3:00 AM. This value must be between 0 (12:00 AM) and 1439 (11:59 PM).
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: durationMinutes
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The duration, in seconds, of the automatic firmware update window. This value must be between 0 and 1440.



### FirmwareUpdate

http://linksys.com/jnap/firmwareupdate/FirmwareUpdate


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: firmwareVersion
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The firmware version.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: firmwareDate
  - **Type**: DateTime
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The date associated with the firmware.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: description
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: An optional description of the firmware update.



### FirmwareUpdateOperationStatus

http://linksys.com/jnap/firmwareupdate/FirmwareUpdateOperationStatus


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: operation
  - **Type**: FirmwareUpdateOperation
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The firmware update operation being performed.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: progressPercent
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The progress of the firmware update operation, as a percentage. This value is always between 0 and 100.



## Enumerations


### FirmwareUpdateOperation

http://linksys.com/jnap/firmwareupdate/FirmwareUpdateOperation


#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: Checking
  - **Description**: The firmware update service is checking for available firmware updates.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Downloading
  - **Description**: The firmware update service is currently downloading a firmware update.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Installing
  - **Description**: The firmware update service is currently installing a firmware update.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Rebooting
  - **Description**: The device is about to reboot after installing a firmware update.



### FirmwareUpdateOperationFailure

http://linksys.com/jnap/firmwareupdate/FirmwareUpdateOperationFailure


#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: CheckFailed
  - **Description**: The firmware update service encountered an error while attempting to check for a firmware update.
- Item:
  - **Value**: DownloadFailed
  - **Description**: The firmware update service encountered an error while attempting to download a firmware update.
- Item:
  - **Value**: InstallFailed
  - **Description**: The firmware update service encountered an error while attempting to install a firmware update.



### FirmwareUpdatePolicy

http://linksys.com/jnap/firmwareupdate/FirmwareUpdatePolicy


#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: Manual
  - **Description**: The device will not automatically check for or install firmware updates.
- Item:
  - **Value**: AutomaticallyCheck
  - **Description**: The device will automatically check for firmware updates, but will not automatically install them.
- Item:
  - **Value**: AutomaticallyCheckAndInstall
  - **Description**: The device will automatically check for and install firmware updates.

### GetGuestNetworkSettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/guestnetwork/GetGuestNetworkSettings

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


#### Output Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: isGuestNetworkEnabled
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether the wireless access point's guest network feature is currently enabled.
- Item:
  - **Name**: broadcastGuestSSID
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether SSID broadcast for the guest network is currently enabled.
- Item:
  - **Name**: guestSSID
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The guest network SSID. The maximum length of this value is 32 bytes.
- Item:
  - **Name**: guestPassword
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The guest network password. Refer to the guestPasswordRestrictions member for specific restrictions placed on the guess network's password.
- Item:
  - **Name**: maxSimultaneousGuests
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The maximum number of users that are allowed on the guest network simultaneously.
- Item:
  - **Name**: canEnableGuestNetwork
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether the wireless access point's guest network feature can be enabled, given the wireless access point's current configuration. This information is necessary, for example, if the wireless access point is a dual-band router that only implements the guest network on one of its radios, and that radio is currently disabled. Note that this value will always be true when isGuestNetworkEnabled is true.
- Item:
  - **Name**: guestPasswordRestrictions
  - **Type**: GuestPasswordRestrictions
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The restrictions that the wireless access point imposes on the guest password.
- Item:
  - **Name**: maxSimultaneousGuestsLimit
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The maximum value that the maxSimultaneousGuests parameter can ever be set to.

### SetGuestNetworkSettings2

http://linksys.com/jnap/guestnetwork/SetGuestNetworkSettings2

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: ipAddress
  - **Type**: IPAddress
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The desired IP address of the gateway on the guest LAN. The following restrictions from RFC 5735 are applied to the guest LAN host address. The guest LAN host address must not fall inside the following reserved ranges: Address Block Description Reference 0.0.0.0/8 "This" Network RFC 1122, Section 3.2.1.3 127.0.0.0/8 Loopback RFC 1122, Section 3.2.1.3 169.254.0.0/16 Link Local RFC 3927 224.0.0.0/4 Multicast RFC 3171 240.0.0.0/4 Reserved for Future Use RFC 1112, Section 4 255.255.255.255/32 Limited Broadcast RFC 919, Section 7 RFC 922, Section 7 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.0 Subnetwork ID RFC 922, Section 7 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.255 Subnetwork Broadcast Address RFC 922, Section 7 Additionally it must not conflict with the LAN subnetwork as returned by http://linksys.com/jnap/router/GetLANSettings.
- Item:
  - **Name**: Address Block
  - **Type**: Description
  - **Optional**: Reference
- Item:
  - **Name**: 0.0.0.0/8
  - **Type**: "This" Network
  - **Optional**: RFC 1122, Section 3.2.1.3
- Item:
  - **Name**: 127.0.0.0/8
  - **Type**: Loopback
  - **Optional**: RFC 1122, Section 3.2.1.3
- Item:
  - **Name**: 169.254.0.0/16
  - **Type**: Link Local
  - **Optional**: RFC 3927
- Item:
  - **Name**: 224.0.0.0/4
  - **Type**: Multicast
  - **Optional**: RFC 3171
- Item:
  - **Name**: 240.0.0.0/4
  - **Type**: Reserved for Future Use
  - **Optional**: RFC 1112, Section 4
- Item:
  - **Name**: 255.255.255.255/32
  - **Type**: Limited Broadcast
  - **Optional**: RFC 919, Section 7 RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.0
  - **Type**: Subnetwork ID
  - **Optional**: RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.255
  - **Type**: Subnetwork Broadcast Address
  - **Optional**: RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: networkPrefixLength
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The desired network prefix length of the guest LAN. This value must be between the minNetworkPrefixLength and maxNetworkPrefixLength values returned by GetGuestNetworkSettings2.
- Item:
  - **Name**: leaseHours
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The length, in hours, a guest is allowed on the guest LAN. This applies to both the guest's DHCP lease and the length of the guest's authorization to use the guest network.

  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The guest network SSID.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: guestPassword
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The guest network password. This only exists when isGuestNetworkACaptivePortal is true.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: guestWPAPassphrase
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The guest network WPA passphrase. This value must either be a 8-63 characters in the range U+0032 - U+007E (printable ASCII) or exactly 64 ASCII hexadecimal digits. This only exists when isGuestNetworkACaptivePortal is false.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: canEnableRadio
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: Whether the wireless access point's guest network radio can be enabled, given the wireless access point's current configuration. This information is necessary, for example, if the wireless access point is a dual-band router that only implements the guest network on one of its radios, and that radio is currently disabled. This value is ignored when used in the context of SetGuestRadioSettings.

# Guest Network Authentication Service

NOTICE: The namespace prefix http://cisco.com/jnap/ has been deprecated but is still supported. All JNAP clients should switch to the new namespace prefix http://linksys.com/jnap/.

Copyright Notice © 2013 Belkin International, Inc. and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.

Contents Services GuestNetworkAuthentication Actions Authenticate


## Services


### GuestNetworkAuthentication

http://linksys.com/jnap/guestnetwork/GuestNetworkAuthentication


#### Service Actions

- Authenticate



## Actions


### Authenticate

http://linksys.com/jnap/guestnetwork/Authenticate

Note: This action does not require HTTP basic authentication.


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: password
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The guest network password. This must match the currently configured guest network password (see http://linksys.com/jnap/guestnetwork/GuestNetwork service)
- Item:
  - **Name**: ipAddress
  - **Type**: IPAddress
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The IP address of the client to authenticate.
- Item:
  - **Name**: macAddress
  - **Type**: MACAddress
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The MAC address of the client to authenticate. If this value is not specified, the client's IP address will be used determine the MAC address.



#### Output Parameters


#### Result

http://linksys.com/jnap/guestnetwork/AuthenticateResult


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: OK
  - **Description**: Success.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Error
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidClient
  - **Description**: The specified client IP address and/or MAC address does not belong to a guest network client.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidPassword
  - **Description**: The supplied guest network password is invalid.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorNetworkDisabled
  - **Description**: The guest access WLAN is not enabled.

## Actions


### GetNetworkConnections

http://linksys.com/jnap/networkconnections/GetNetworkConnections

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: macAddresses
  - **Type**: MACAddress[]
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: An optional list of MAC addresses. If this value is specified, information will be returned only for wireless connections in which the wireless client's MAC address appears in the list. If this value is not specified, the returned list of wireless connections will not be filtered by MAC address. Note that if an empty array is specified for this value, the returned list of wireless connections will always be empty.



#### Output Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: connections
  - **Type**: Layer2Connection[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of devices, if any, that satisfy the specified filter criteria.



#### Result

http://linksys.com/jnap/networkconnections/GetNetworkConnectionsResult


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: OK
  - **Description**: Success.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Error
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorAbortedAction
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorInvalidInput
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorInvalidOutput
  - **Description**: 
- Item:

  - **Description**:

- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorUnknownSession

#### Sample Transaction

POST [request-uri] HTTP/1.1 Host: 192.168.1.1 Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8 Content-Length: [number of octets in request body] X-JNAP-Action: "http://linksys.com/jnap/networkconnections/GetNetworkConnections" { "macAddresses": [ "00:22:5F:A1:73:C1" ] }

HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8 Content-Length: [number of octets in response body] { "result": "OK", "output": { "connections": [ { "macAddress": "00:22:5F:A1:73:C1", "negotiatedMbps": 123, "wireless": { "bssid": "00:22:6B:62:B0:0E", "isGuest": true, "band": "2.4GHz", "signalDecibels": -72 } } ] } }

### RefreshSlaveBackhaulData

http://linksys.com/jnap/nodes/diagnostics/RefreshSlaveBackhaulData


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: deviceUUID
  - **Type**: UUID
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The device UUID of a specific Slave Node of interest. If this parameter is ommitted, the backhaul data will be refreshed for all Slave Nodes. The results can be retrieved by calling action GetBackhaulInfo.



#### Output Parameters


#### Result

http://linksys.com/jnap/nodes/diagnostics/RefreshSlaveBackhaulDataResult


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: OK
  - **Description**: Success.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Error
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorDeviceDataNotFound
  - **Description**: Could not find backhaul data for the given deviceUUID. This indicates that either the Slave is off-line, or deviceUUID is invalid.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorDeviceNotInMasterMode
  - **Description**: The action only works in Master mode.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorEmptyDataFile
  - **Description**: The backhaul status file for deviceUUID exists, but is empty.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorParentIPNotFound
  - **Description**: Could not find the IP addresss of the parent Node for deviceUUID.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorSetupInProgress
  - **Description**: The action cannot be run while smartconnect setup is in progress.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorStatusFileNotFound
  - **Description**: The backhaul status file was not found for the given deviceUUID. This indicates that the Slave has gone off-line.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorUnknownConnectionType
  - **Description**: The backhaul connection type for deviceUUID is unknown.
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorAbortedAction
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorDisallowedAction
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorInvalidInput
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorInvalidOutput
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorNotReady
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorSessionVerification
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorUnauthorized
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorUnexpected
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: _ErrorUnknownAction
  - **Description**:

  - **Description**:

- Item:

  - **Type**: FirmwareUpdateOperationStatus
  - **Optional**: yes

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: lastOperationFailure
  - **Type**: FirmwareUpdateOperationFailure
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The reason why the most recent attempted firmware update operation failed. This value will not be present if the pendingOperation parameter is present, or if the most recent firmware update operation succeeded.

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: macAddresses
  - **Type**: MACAddress[]
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: An optional list of MAC addresses. If this value is specified, information will be returned only for wireless connections in which the wireless client's MAC address appears in the list. If this value is not specified, the returned list of wireless connections will not be filtered by MAC address. Note that if an empty array is specified for this value, the returned list of wireless connections will always be empty.
- Item:
  - **Name**: deviceIDs
  - **Type**: UUID[]
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: An optional list of Node DeviceIDs you're interested in. If this value is specified, information will be returned only for wireless connections from the Node whose DeviceID appears in the list. If this value is not specified, the returned list of wireless connections will not be filtered. Note that if an empty array is specified for this value, the returned list of wireless connections will always be empty.



#### Output Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: lastTriggered
  - **Type**: DateTime
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The time when the wireless network connection refresh was last triggered. This value will not be returned if a refresh has not been triggered.
- Item:
  - **Name**: nodeWirelessConnections
  - **Type**: NodeWirelessConnection[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of devices, if any, that satisfy the specified filter criteria. This list will be returned as soon as data becomes available.

### GetNodesWirelessNetworkConnections2

http://linksys.com/jnap/nodes/networkconnections/GetNodesWirelessNetworkConnections2

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: macAddresses
  - **Type**: MACAddress[]
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: An optional list of MAC addresses. If this value is specified, information will be returned only for wireless connections in which the wireless client's MAC address appears in the list. If this value is not specified, the returned list of wireless connections will not be filtered by MAC address. Note that if an empty array is specified for this value, the returned list of wireless connections will always be empty.
- Item:
  - **Name**: deviceIDs
  - **Type**: UUID[]
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: An optional list of Node DeviceIDs you're interested in. If this value is specified, information will be returned only for wireless connections from the Node whose DeviceID appears in the list. If this value is not specified, the returned list of wireless connections will not be filtered. Note that if an empty array is specified for this value, the returned list of wireless connections will always be empty.



#### Output Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: lastTriggered
  - **Type**: DateTime
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The time when the wireless network connection refresh was last triggered. This value will not be returned if a refresh has not been triggered.
- Item:
  - **Name**: nodeWirelessConnections
  - **Type**: NodeWirelessConnection2[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of devices, if any, that satisfy the specified filter criteria. This list will be returned as soon as data becomes available.

Note that this parameter is logically distinct from the session token that can be passed in the JNAP headers; the parameter is not used to authenticate the caller, but simply to identify the user who should become the network owner. The JNAP headers are used to authenticate the caller's permission to invoke the API at all.
- Item:

  - **Description**: The friendly name to associate with this network. If not set the router's hostname will be used. There are currently no explicitly defined restrictions on this value.

### GetQoSSettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/qos/GetQoSSettings

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


#### Output Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: isQoSEnabled
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether QoS is currently enabled.
- Item:
  - **Name**: isQoSAutoPrioritizingEnabled
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether QoS auto-prioritizing is currently enabled. QoS auto-prioritizing automatically assigns QoS priorities for devices from values returned from a web-service. When enabled, device priorities are automatically updated as device becomes more accurately identified.
- Item:
  - **Name**: upstreamBandwidthbps
  - **Type**: long
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The upstream bandwidth, in bits per second. This value is used effectively allocate bandwidth between all data streams. The closer this value is to the actual value, the more efficient the QoS system will operate. If this value is 0, the upstream bandwidth is determined automatically.
- Item:
  - **Name**: downstreamBandwidthbps
  - **Type**: long
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The downstream bandwidth, in bits per second. This value is used effectively allocate bandwidth between all data streams. The closer this value is to the actual value, the more efficient the QoS system will operate. If this value is 0, the downstream bandwidth is determined automatically.
- Item:
  - **Name**: deviceRules
  - **Type**: QoSDeviceRule[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of rules that apply to specific devices. This value is returned regardless of the value of isQoSEnabled.
- Item:
  - **Name**: applicationRules
  - **Type**: QoSApplicationRule[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of rules that apply to specific applications. This value is returned regardless of the value of isQoSEnabled.
- Item:
  - **Name**: maxDescriptionLength
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The maximum allowed length of a rule description.
- Item:
  - **Name**: maxApplicationRules
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The maximum number of QoS application rules that can exist simultaneously.
- Item:
  - **Name**: maxPortRanges
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The maximum number of port ranges allowed per application rule.
- Item:
  - **Name**: maxDeviceRules
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The maximum number of QoS device rules that can exist simultaneously.

### SetQoSSettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/qos/SetQoSSettings

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: isQoSEnabled
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether QoS should be enabled.
- Item:
  - **Name**: isQoSAutoPrioritizingEnabled
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether QoS auto-prioritizing is currently enabled.
- Item:
  - **Name**: upstreamBandwidthbps
  - **Type**: long
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The upstream bandwidth, in bits per second. This value is used effectively allocate bandwidth between all data streams. The closer this value is to the actual value, the more efficient the QoS system will operate. If this value is 0, the upstream bandwidth is determined automatically.
- Item:
  - **Name**: downstreamBandwidthbps
  - **Type**: long
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The downstream bandwidth, in bits per second. This value is used effectively allocate bandwidth between all data streams. The closer this value is to the actual value, the more efficient the QoS system will operate. If this value is 0, the downstream bandwidth is determined automatically.
- Item:
  - **Name**: deviceRules
  - **Type**: QoSDeviceRule[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of rules that apply to specific devices. If the value of the isQoSEnabled parameter is false, the new rules are saved but have no immediate effect.
- Item:
  - **Name**: applicationRules
  - **Type**: QoSApplicationRule[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of rules that apply to specific applications. If the value of the isQoSEnabled parameter is false, the rules are saved but have no immediate no effect.

  - **Description**: Two or more of the application rules contain conflicting port ranges.

  - **Description**: Two or more of the device rules contain conflicting MAC addresses.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorDescriptionTooLong
  - **Description**: One of the specified rule descriptions was longer than the maximum allowed length.

  - **Description**: The number of application rules exceeded the maximum allowed.

  - **Description**: The number of device rules exceeded the maximum allowed.

## Structures


### QoSApplicationPortRange

#### Structure Members

  - **Type**: QoSProtocol
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The protocol of the port range.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: firstPort
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The first port in the port range. This value must be between 0 and 65535
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: lastPort
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The last port in the port range. This value must be between 0 and 65535 and greater than or equal to firstPort. If not present, the value of firstPortwill be used.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: priority
  - **Type**: QoSPriority
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The priority of the traffic matching this port range.

  - **Notes**: Added Router9 service to indicate bridge mode support in newer Nodes FW. NOTE: This a service revision only -- no other changes.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 8.0.1
  - **Date**: 2017-06-20
  - **Notes**: Move optional lanPrefixAddress to output of GetWANStatus3, and remove struct IPv6NetworkInfo2
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 8.0.0
  - **Date**: 2017-01-20
  - **Notes**: Added Router8 service for configuring WAN settings with optional VLAN tagging. Introduced: action GetWANSettings4 action SetWANSettings4 error ErrorWANTaggingNotSupported Router7 has been deprecated.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 7.0.0
  - **Date**: 2016-03-16
  - **Notes**: Added Router7 service. Consolidated Router4 and Router6. Introduced: action GetWANSettings3 Router3, Router4, and Router6 have been deprecated.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 6.0.0
  - **Date**: 2015-11-15
  - **Notes**: Added Router6 service that supports express forwarding. Added the following: enum GetExpressForwardingSettings struct SetExpressForwardingSettings
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 5.0.0
  - **Date**: 2015-02-23
  - **Notes**: Added Router5 service that supports configuring PPPoE and Pass-through on IPv6. Added the following: enum WANIPv6Type2 struct SupportedWANCombination struct WANIPv6ConnectionInfo2 struct IPv6NetworkInfo2 struct IPv6AutomaticSettings action GetIPv6Settings2 action SetIPv6Settings2 action GetWANStatus3 error ErrorMissingIPv6AutomaticSettings error ErrorSuperfluousIPv6AutomaticSettings

### SetLANSettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/router/SetLANSettings

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: ipAddress
  - **Type**: IPAddress
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The desired IP address of the router on the LAN. The following restrictions from RFC 5735 are applied to the router's LAN host address. The router's LAN host address must not fall inside the following reserved ranges: Address Block Description Reference 0.0.0.0/8 "This" Network RFC 1122, Section 3.2.1.3 127.0.0.0/8 Loopback RFC 1122, Section 3.2.1.3 169.254.0.0/16 Link Local RFC 3927 224.0.0.0/4 Multicast RFC 3171 240.0.0.0/4 Reserved for Future Use RFC 1112, Section 4 255.255.255.255/32 Limited Broadcast RFC 919, Section 7 RFC 922, Section 7 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.0 Subnetwork ID RFC 922, Section 7 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.255 Subnetwork Broadcast Address RFC 922, Section 7 Additionally it must not conflict with the guest LAN subnetwork as returned by http://linksys.com/jnap/guestnetwork/GetGuestNetworkSettings2.
- Item:
  - **Name**: Address Block
  - **Type**: Description
  - **Optional**: Reference
- Item:
  - **Name**: 0.0.0.0/8
  - **Type**: "This" Network
  - **Optional**: RFC 1122, Section 3.2.1.3
- Item:
  - **Name**: 127.0.0.0/8
  - **Type**: Loopback
  - **Optional**: RFC 1122, Section 3.2.1.3
- Item:
  - **Name**: 169.254.0.0/16
  - **Type**: Link Local
  - **Optional**: RFC 3927
- Item:
  - **Name**: 224.0.0.0/4
  - **Type**: Multicast
  - **Optional**: RFC 3171
- Item:
  - **Name**: 240.0.0.0/4
  - **Type**: Reserved for Future Use
  - **Optional**: RFC 1112, Section 4
- Item:
  - **Name**: 255.255.255.255/32
  - **Type**: Limited Broadcast
  - **Optional**: RFC 919, Section 7 RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.0
  - **Type**: Subnetwork ID
  - **Optional**: RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: 192.168.1.0/24: 192.168.1.255
  - **Type**: Subnetwork Broadcast Address
  - **Optional**: RFC 922, Section 7
- Item:
  - **Name**: networkPrefixLength
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The desired network prefix length of the LAN. This value must be between the minNetworkPrefixLength and maxNetworkPrefixLength values returned by GetLANSettings.
- Item:
  - **Name**: hostName
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The desired host name of the router on the LAN. This value must be between 1 and 15 characters and otherwise follow the format restrictions defined in RFC 952.
- Item:
  - **Name**: isDHCPEnabled
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether the router is currently acting as a DHCP server for other devices on the LAN.
- Item:
  - **Name**: dhcpSettings
  - **Type**: DHCPSettings
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: Configurable settings of the router's DHCP server. This value may be omitted if isDHCPEnabled is false.



#### Output Parameters


#### Result

http://linksys.com/jnap/router/SetLANSettingsResult


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: OK
  - **Description**: Success.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Error
  - **Description**: 
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidFirstClientIPAddress
  - **Description**: The specified first client IP address in the allowed range is not valid.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidHostName
  - **Description**: The specified host name is not valid.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidIPAddress
  - **Description**: The specified router IP address is not valid.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidLastClientIPAddress
  - **Description**: The specified last client IP address in the allowed range is not valid.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidLeaseMinutes
  - **Description**: The specified DHCP lease length is outside the allowed range.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidNetworkPrefixLength
  - **Description**: The specified network prefix is invalid or is not supported by the router.
- Item:
  - **Value**: ErrorInvalidPrimaryDNSServer
  - **Description**: The specified primary DNS server IP addresses is not invalid.

  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The number of minutes in the DHCP lease. If the value of the wanType parameter is not DHCPv6, this value will not be present.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: dnsServer1
  - **Type**: IPv6Address
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The IP address of the primary DNS server.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: dnsServer2
  - **Type**: IPv6Address
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The IP address of the secondary DNS server, if any.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: dnsServer3
  - **Type**: IPv6Address
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The IP address of the tertiary DNS server, if any.



### IPv6rdTunnelSettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/router/IPv6rdTunnelSettings


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: prefix
  - **Type**: IPv6Address
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The IPv6 prefix, specified as an IPv6 address with all bits after the prefix set to 0.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: prefixLength
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The IPv6 prefix length. This value must be between 0 and 64.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: borderRelay
  - **Type**: IPAddress
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The IPv4 address of the border relay.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: borderRelayPrefixLength
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The IPv4 border relay network prefix length. This value must be between 0 and 32. The value (prefixLength - borderRelayPrefixLength) must be less than or equal to 32.



### NamedStaticRouteEntry

http://linksys.com/jnap/router/NamedStaticRouteEntry


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: name
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The name of the entry.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: settings
  - **Type**: StaticRouteEntry
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The location of the Destination LAN IP address.



### PPPoESettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/router/PPPoESettings


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: username
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The username to be used for the connection. This value must be between 0 and 255 characters.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: password
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The password to be used for the connection. This value must be between 0 and 255 characters.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: serviceName
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The service name to be used for the connection. This value may be an empty string for some service providers. This value must be between 0 and 255 characters.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: behavior
  - **Type**: PPPConnectionBehavior
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The connection behavior.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: maxIdleMinutes
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The maximum number of minutes that the connection can be idle before it is automatically disconnected. This value is required if the value of the behavior member is ConnectOnDemand. This value must be between 1 and 9999.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: reconnectAfterSeconds
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The number of seconds to wait before automatically reconnecting after the connection is disconnected. This value is required if the value of the behavior member is KeepAlive. This value must be between 20 and 180.

### WANStatus

#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: Indeterminate
  - **Description**: The router cannot determine the status of its WAN connection.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Disconnected
  - **Description**: The router's WAN port is not connected at layer 2, and the router is not in the process of negotiating connectivity.
- Item:
  - **Value**: LimitedConnection
  - **Description**: The router's WAN port is connected at layer 2, but the router cannot send or receive IP packets and is not in the process of negotiating IP connectivity.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Connecting
  - **Description**: The router's WAN port is in the process of negotiating IP connectivity (for example, using DHCP).
- Item:
  - **Value**: Connected
  - **Description**: The router can send and receive IP packets on the WAN.

http://linksys.com/jnap/wirelessap/WirelessSecurity


#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: None
  - **Description**: No authentication or encryption; commonly referred to as "open".
- Item:
  - **Value**: WEP
  - **Description**: WEP protocol with no authentication and WEP encryption using a preshared key; commonly referred to as "WEP shared".
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Personal
  - **Description**: WPA protocol with preshared-key authentication and TKIP encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Enterprise
  - **Description**: WPA protocol with RADIUS authentication and TKIP encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA2-Personal
  - **Description**: WPA2 protocol with preshared-key authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA2-Enterprise
  - **Description**: WPA2 protocol with RADIUS authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Mixed-Personal
  - **Description**: Either WPA-Personal or WPA2-Personal.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Mixed-Enterprise
  - **Description**: Either WPA-Enterprise or WPA2-Enterprise.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA2/WPA3-Mixed-Personal
  - **Description**: Either WPA2-Personal or WPA3-Personal.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA3-Personal
  - **Description**: WPA3 protocol with preshared-key authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA3-Enterprise
  - **Description**: WPA3 protocol with RADIUS authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Enhanced-Open+None
  - **Description**: Wi-Fi Alliance®'s Wi-Fi CERTIFIED Enhanced Open™ OWE Transition mode. See http://wi-fi.org/enhanced-open.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Enhanced-Open-Only
  - **Description**: Wi-Fi Alliance®'s Wi-Fi CERTIFIED Enhanced Open™ OWE Only mode. See http://wi-fi.org/enhanced-open.

### SetManagementSettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/routermanagement/SetManagementSettings

Note: This action is safe to call within the context of a transaction.


#### Input Parameters


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Name**: canManageUsingHTTP
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether clients on the LAN should be able to manage the router over HTTP. If the value of this parameter is false, the value of the canManageUsingHTTPS parameter must be true.
- Item:
  - **Name**: canManageUsingHTTPS
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether clients on the LAN should be able to manage the router over HTTPS. If the value of this parameter is false, the value of the canManageUsingHTTP parameter must be true.
- Item:
  - **Name**: canManageWirelessly
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether clients connected wirelessly to the LAN should be able to manage the router.
- Item:
  - **Name**: canManageRemotely
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether clients should be allowed to manage the router from the WAN. Note that the GetRemoteManagementServiceStatus action should be used to determine if remote management is possible as various issues, such as connection problems, could still prevent remote management.

- Item:
  - **Value**: Stopped
  - **Description**: The remote management service is not running. This value will be returned if the WAN connection is down.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Connecting
  - **Description**: The remote management service is attempting to connect with the external (cloud) servers.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Connected
  - **Description**: The remote management service is connected. Remote management is only possible in this state.

## Change History


**Details:**

- Item:

- Item:

  - **Date**: 2023-02-21
  - **Notes**: Removed the following action definitions, as they were never implemented: RefreshWirelessNetworks GetRefreshWirelessNetworksStatus CheckForSSIDCollision
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 9.0.0
  - **Date**: 2022-10-06
  - **Notes**: Added service Setup9 with the following: action StartBlinkingNodeLed action StopBlinkingNodeLed
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 8.0.0
  - **Date**: 2021-09-28
  - **Notes**: Added Setup8 service to meet the password requirements for IMDA certification. Introduced: Output parameter isLockoutIndefinite in action VerifyRouterResetCode Action SetAdminPassword2
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 7.0.0
  - **Date**: 2019-07-17
  - **Notes**: Added Setup7 service to indicate the following actions now require authentication: GetSerialNumber GetWANDetectionStatus GetVersionInfo GetWANConnectionInfo
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 6.0.0
  - **Date**: 2019-03-25
  - **Notes**: Added service Setup6 to resolve issue NODES-11707. The presence of Setup6 indicates that GetWANDetectionStatus now returns the correct state values for isDetectingWANType and detectedWANType. Prior to this revision, GetWANDetectionStatus always returned false for isDetectingWANType, and it returned the current WAN type for detectedWANType. NOTE: This a service revision only -- no other changes.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 5.0.0
  - **Date**: 2018-08-17
  - **Notes**: Split Setup4 service into two services: Setup5 and SelectableWAN. GetPortConnectionStatus, GetWANPort and SetWANPort are now part of SelectableWAN service. This is necessary for clients to tell whether the router has a dedicated WAN port or not.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 4.0.2
  - **Date**: 2018-02-23
  - **Notes**: Added Bluetooth errors in GetDeviceID to indicate Bluetooth error type.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 4.0.1
  - **Date**: 2017-10-30
  - **Notes**: Added service Setup4, which includes the following: action GetVersionInfo action GetWANConnectionInfo
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 3.0.2
  - **Date**: 2017-06-22
  - **Notes**: Added the following: action StartWiredBlinkingNode action StopWiredBlinkingNode
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 3.0.1
  - **Date**: 2017-06-22
  - **Notes**: Added service Setup3 to indicate that jnap/core/Reboot now also reboots child nodes.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 2.0.1
  - **Date**: 2017-05-30
  - **Notes**: Added service Setup2, which includes new action GetWANPort.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.10
  - **Date**: 2016-12-01
  - **Notes**: Changed the GetDeviceID checking to match the currently connected BT peer, then getting deviceID from Slave via BT GetDeviceID over BT.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.9
  - **Date**: 2016-11-22
  - **Notes**: Added the following: action GetInternetConnectionStatus
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.8
  - **Date**: 2016-11-17
  - **Notes**: Added the following: action GetPortConnectionStatus action SetWANPort
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.7

  - **Notes**: Action GetDeviceID now accepts an optional macAddress.
- Item:

  - **Notes**: Action IsAdminPasswordSetByUser can be called remotely.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.5

  - **Notes**: Added action GetWiredUnconfiguredNodes for getting the wired unconfigured nodes.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.4
  - **Date**: 2016-10-22
  - **Notes**: Added action GetWANDetectionStatus for getting the WAN detection status over bluetooth during setup.
- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.3
  - **Date**: 2016-09-14
  - **Notes**: Added APIs for Spot Finder feature. Added the following: action GetMACAddress action GetDeviceID action GetConnectedNodesDeviceID action GetNodesWirelessConnectionInfo

### WANStatus

http://linksys.com/jnap/router/WANStatus


#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: Indeterminate
  - **Description**: The router cannot determine the status of its WAN connection.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Disconnected
  - **Description**: The router's WAN port is not connected at layer 2, and the router is not in the process of negotiating connectivity.
- Item:
  - **Value**: LimitedConnection
  - **Description**: The router's WAN port is connected at layer 2, but the router cannot send or receive IP packets and is not in the process of negotiating IP connectivity.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Connecting
  - **Description**: The router's WAN port is in the process of negotiating IP connectivity (for example, using DHCP).
- Item:
  - **Value**: Connected
  - **Description**: The router can send and receive IP packets on the WAN.

### WirelessSecurity

http://linksys.com/jnap/wirelessap/WirelessSecurity


#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: None
  - **Description**: No authentication or encryption; commonly referred to as "open".
- Item:
  - **Value**: WEP
  - **Description**: WEP protocol with no authentication and WEP encryption using a preshared key; commonly referred to as "WEP shared".
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Personal
  - **Description**: WPA protocol with preshared-key authentication and TKIP encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Enterprise
  - **Description**: WPA protocol with RADIUS authentication and TKIP encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA2-Personal
  - **Description**: WPA2 protocol with preshared-key authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA2-Enterprise
  - **Description**: WPA2 protocol with RADIUS authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Mixed-Personal
  - **Description**: Either WPA-Personal or WPA2-Personal.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Mixed-Enterprise
  - **Description**: Either WPA-Enterprise or WPA2-Enterprise.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA2/WPA3-Mixed-Personal
  - **Description**: Either WPA2-Personal or WPA3-Personal.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA3-Personal
  - **Description**: WPA3 protocol with preshared-key authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA3-Enterprise
  - **Description**: WPA3 protocol with RADIUS authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Enhanced-Open+None
  - **Description**: Wi-Fi Alliance®'s Wi-Fi CERTIFIED Enhanced Open™ OWE Transition mode. See http://wi-fi.org/enhanced-open.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Enhanced-Open-Only
  - **Description**: Wi-Fi Alliance®'s Wi-Fi CERTIFIED Enhanced Open™ OWE Only mode. See http://wi-fi.org/enhanced-open.

  - **Notes**: Added result ErrorUnsupportedMode to action SmartConnectConfigure.
- Item:

- Item:
  - **Revision**: 2.0.1
  - **Date**: 2017-08-04
  - **Notes**: Deprecated the following at service SmartConnect2: action GetSlaveSetupStatus Added the following at service SmartConnect2: action GetSlaveSetupStatus2

- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.3

  - **Notes**: Added the following: action SmartConnectConfigure

- Item:
  - **Revision**: 1.0.1

## Structures


### AdvancedRadioInfo

http://linksys.com/jnap/wirelessap/AdvancedRadioInfo


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: radioID
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The unique identifier of the radio. This value never changes for a particular radio, and no two radios on the same wireless access point will have the same radio ID.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: supportedRatesMbps
  - **Type**: int[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of supported transmission rates, in megabits per second, that the radio supports. The presence of the value 0 in this list indicates that the radio supports transmission rate auto-selection.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: supportedNRatesMbps
  - **Type**: string[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of supported 802.11n transmission rates, in megabits per second, that the radio supports. The presence of the value 0 in this list indicates that the radio supports transmission rate auto-selection.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: settings
  - **Type**: AdvancedRadioSettings
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The radio's current advanced settings.



### AdvancedRadioSettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/wirelessap/AdvancedRadioSettings


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: apIsolation
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: Is AP isolation enabled? If enabled, all traffic between wireless client stations will be dropped. In other words, wireless device to wireless device direct communication will fail.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: frameburst
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: Is frameburst emabled? This will allow a wireless client station to send multiple frames between wait periods, thus increasing upload throughput. It is only recommend for WLANs with few (1-3) clients.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: ctsProtection
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: Is CTS protection mode enabled? This value will ensure that 802.11b wireless client stations can connect to an 802.11g access point when 802.11g wireless client stations are also connected. This will negatively affect performance.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: rateMbps
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The fixed transmission rate, in Megabits per second. 0 indicates that the radio supports transmission rate auto-selection.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: nRateMbps
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The fixed 802.11n transmission rate, in Megabits per second. 0 indicates that the radio supports transmission rate auto-selection.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: basicRate
  - **Type**: WirelessBasicTransmissionRate
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The basic transmission rate set.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: transmissionPower
  - **Type**: WirelessTransmissionPower
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The relative wireless transmission power.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: greenfieldPreamble
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: Is the Greenfield preamble enabled?
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: htDuplicate
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: HT Duplicate
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: spaceTimeBlockCode
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: Space Time Block Code
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: wirelessMultimediaPowerSave
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: Wireless Multimedia Power Save
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: beaconIntervalMilliseconds
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The beacon interval, in milliseconds. This must be between 1 and 65535.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: dtimIntervalMilliseconds
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The DTIM interval. in milliseconds. This must be between 1 and 255.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: fragmentationThresholdBytes
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The fragmentation threshold, in bytes. This must be between 256 and 2346.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: rtsThresholdBytes
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The RTS threshold, in bytes. This must be between 0 and 2347.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: wepAuthentication
  - **Type**: WEPAuthentication
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The WEP authentication type.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: sidebandSelection

### RadioInfo

http://linksys.com/jnap/wirelessap/RadioInfo


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: radioID
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The unique identifier of the radio. This value never changes for a particular radio, and no two radios on the same wireless access point will have the same radio ID.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: physicalRadioID
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The unique identifier of the physical radio hardware. This value never changes for a particular radio. However, multiple radios within the wireless access point may have the same physical radio ID if the access point has a selectable-band radio. In this case, radios that have the same physical radio ID represent mutually-exclusive configurations of the same physical radio, and modifying settings of one radio will cause the settings of the other radio to be modified as well. Only one of the radios that share a physical radio can be enabled at any given time; enabling such a radio will cause the other radios to be disabled.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: bssid
  - **Type**: MACAddress
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The radio's BSSID.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: band
  - **Type**: WirelessBand
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The radio's wireless frequency band.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: supportedModes
  - **Type**: WirelessMode[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of wireless modes that the radio supports.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: supportedChannels
  - **Type**: int[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of standard (20 MHz) wireless channels that the radio supports The presence of the value 0 in this list indicates that the radio supports channel auto-selection. Note that the list of supported channels depends on the access point's configured locale, since certain channels are only supported in certain regions.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: supportedWideChannels
  - **Type**: int[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of wide (40 MHz) wireless channels that the radio supports The presence of the value 0 in this list indicates that the radio supports wide channel auto-selection. This list may be empty if the radio does not support wide channels. Note that the list of supported wide channels depends on the access point's configured locale, since certain wide channels are only supported in certain regions.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: supportedSecurityTypes
  - **Type**: WirelessSecurity[]
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The list of wireless security types that the radio supports.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: maxRADIUSSharedKeyLength
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The maximum allowed length, in bytes, of a RADIUS shared key value.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: settings
  - **Type**: RadioSettings
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The radio's current settings.

### RadioSettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/wirelessap/RadioSettings


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: isEnabled
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether the radio is enabled.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: mode
  - **Type**: WirelessMode
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The radio's mode.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: ssid
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The radio's SSID. The maximum length of this value is 32 bytes.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: broadcastSSID
  - **Type**: bool
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: Whether SSID broadcast is enabled.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: channelWidth
  - **Type**: WirelessChannelWidth
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The wireless channel width that the radio operates on. Note that "Wide" is not allowed when mode is set to "802.11a". 802.11a does not support wide channels.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: channel
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The wireless channel the radio should operate on. The value 0 indicates that the wireless access point should auto-select the channel.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: security
  - **Type**: WirelessSecurity
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The radio's security type.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: wepSettings
  - **Type**: WEPSettings
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The radio's WEP settings. When getting wireless radio settings, this value will be present if and only if the value of the security member is WEP. When setting wireless radio settings, this value is required if the value of the security member is WEP; if the security is not WEP, this value is ignored if present.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: wpaPersonalSettings
  - **Type**: WPAPersonalSettings
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The radio's WPA-Personal settings. When getting wireless radio settings, this value will be present if and only if the value of the security member is a WPA-Personal variant. When setting wireless radio settings, this value is required if the value of the security member is a WPA-Personal variant; if the security is not a WPA-Personal variant, this value is ignored if present.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: wpaEnterpriseSettings
  - **Type**: WPAEnterpriseSettings
  - **Optional**: yes
  - **Description**: The radio's WPA-Enterprise settings. When getting wireless radio settings, this value will be present if and only if the value of the security member is a WPA-Enterprise variant. When setting wireless radio settings, this value is required if the value of the security member is a WPA-Enterprise variant; if the security is not a WPA-Enterprise variant, this value is ignored if present.
