### WEPSettings

http://linksys.com/jnap/wirelessap/WEPSettings


#### Structure Members


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Member Name**: encryption
  - **Type**: WEPEncryption
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The WEP encryption type.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: key1
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The first WEP key value. If the value of the encryption member is WEP-64, this value must be exactly 10 hexadecimal digits or an empty string. If the value of the encryption member is WEP-128, this value must be exactly 26 hexadecimal digits or an empty string. Specifying the empty string will clear the key if it was previously set.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: key2
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The second WEP key value. If the value of the encryption member is WEP-64, this value must be exactly 10 hexadecimal digits or an empty string. If the value of the encryption member is WEP-128, this value must be exactly 26 hexadecimal digits or an empty string. Specifying the empty string will clear the key if it was previously set.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: key3
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The third WEP key value. If the value of the encryption member is WEP-64, this value must be exactly 10 hexadecimal digits or an empty string. If the value of the encryption member is WEP-128, this value must be exactly 26 hexadecimal digits or an empty string. Specifying the empty string will clear the key if it was previously set.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: key4
  - **Type**: string
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The fourth WEP key value. If the value of the encryption member is WEP-64, this value must be exactly 10 hexadecimal digits or an empty string. If the value of the encryption member is WEP-128, this value must be exactly 26 hexadecimal digits or an empty string. Specifying the empty string will clear the key if it was previously set.
- Item:
  - **Member Name**: txKey
  - **Type**: int
  - **Optional**: no
  - **Description**: The index specifying which key value to use for encryption. The value of the corresponding key cannot be an empty string. This value must be between 1 and 4.

### WEPAuthentication

http://linksys.com/jnap/wirelessap/WEPAuthentication


#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: Auto
  - **Description**: Automatically choose the authentication type for each wireless client station.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Open
  - **Description**: Use open-system authentication. Wireless client stations will not be required to authenticate to complete the 802.11 association process.
- Item:
  - **Value**: SharedKey
  - **Description**: Use shared key authentication. Wireless clients must prove ownership of the WEP shared secret as part of the 802.11 association process.

http://linksys.com/jnap/wirelessap/WEPEncryption


#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: WEP-64
  - **Description**: 64-bit WEP encryption with a 40-bit key. This value should only be used when the security type is WEP.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WEP-128
  - **Description**: 128-bit WEP encryption with a 104-bit key. This value should only be used when the security type is WEP.

### WirelessSecurity

http://linksys.com/jnap/wirelessap/WirelessSecurity


#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: None
  - **Description**: No authentication or encryption; commonly referred to as "open".
- Item:
  - **Value**: WEP
  - **Description**: WEP protocol with no authentication and WEP encryption using a preshared key; commonly referred to as "WEP shared".
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Personal
  - **Description**: WPA protocol with preshared-key authentication and TKIP encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Enterprise
  - **Description**: WPA protocol with RADIUS authentication and TKIP encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA2-Personal
  - **Description**: WPA2 protocol with preshared-key authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA2-Enterprise
  - **Description**: WPA2 protocol with RADIUS authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Mixed-Personal
  - **Description**: Either WPA-Personal or WPA2-Personal.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA-Mixed-Enterprise
  - **Description**: Either WPA-Enterprise or WPA2-Enterprise.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA2/WPA3-Mixed-Personal
  - **Description**: Either WPA2-Personal or WPA3-Personal.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA3-Personal
  - **Description**: WPA3 protocol with preshared-key authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: WPA3-Enterprise
  - **Description**: WPA3 protocol with RADIUS authentication and AES encryption.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Enhanced-Open+None
  - **Description**: Wi-Fi Alliance®'s Wi-Fi CERTIFIED Enhanced Open™ OWE Transition mode. See http://wi-fi.org/enhanced-open.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Enhanced-Open-Only
  - **Description**: Wi-Fi Alliance®'s Wi-Fi CERTIFIED Enhanced Open™ OWE Only mode. See http://wi-fi.org/enhanced-open.



### WirelessTransmissionPower

http://linksys.com/jnap/wirelessap/WirelessTransmissionPower


#### Enumeration Values


**Details:**

- Item:
  - **Value**: Low
  - **Description**: Low transmission power.
- Item:
  - **Value**: Medium
  - **Description**: Medium transmission power.
- Item:
  - **Value**: High
  - **Description**: High transmission power.

  - **Description**: Smart Connect setup did not complete within 2 minutes.
